desc: Run sample tests and exhaustive brute-force validation against the greedy algorithm.
Determine an efficient data structure for finding adjustable positions in each violated window and checking whether an `'F'` window equals `str2`, within the limits.
Analyze edge cases such as `m=1`, all `'T'`, all `'F'`, overlapping occurrences, and impossible conflicts.
Implement the final `generateString(self, str1: str, str2: str) -> str` solution and verify its complexity limits.
